I am a software engineer and early-career AI researcher based in Singapore. My work focuses on reinforcement learning, multi-agent systems, and trustworthy AI.

I learn by rebuilding methods from first principles: deriving the mathematics, implementing the algorithm without high-level abstractions, and then testing what the derivation predicts.

My current research direction is **trust-aware multi-agent LLM systems**: how an aggregation system can learn which agents to rely on when some participants are noisy, unreliable, or adversarial.

## Education

- **M.Sc. in Information Technology**, Eastern Mediterranean University, 2024
- **B.Sc. in Computer Software Engineering**, Islamic Azad University, Najafabad, 2015
